comment: Use the known D:5 general-store setup to pick up an unpaid floor item. C objnam.c:wizterrainwish rejects making a door on ordinary floor, so first turn the occupied shop floor square into a wall and then wish a broken door there; wizterrainwish changes lev->typ/doormask without rebuilding the level's room rectangles. Step diagonally away and back into the new D_BROKEN square. C test_move's doorless_door result is true for this mask, so its source expression evaluates block_door at the same in-shop coordinates. The matching recording proves execution through the caller; it does not infer which block_door condition produced its false result.
